rule: Reserve membership may not change because of system performance. A failure found during engineering goes to the challenge-candidate queue, never into or out of this set.
erratum_policy: A reserve case later shown to be objectively invalid is recorded as a benchmark erratum and retained. It is never silently replaced.
access_policy: Opening reserve.json requires an explicit owner decision and one appended entry in reserve-access.log.jsonl written BEFORE the read. No tuning decision may be informed by reserve content.
unlock_requires: an explicit owner decision recorded as an erratum
